framing: ALL empirical results in this project are SIMULATED-DATA-ONLY ([simulated] synthetic-from-physics SST-anomaly-like fields; art origin synthetic-[simulated]-from-physics on every artifact). No claim of real-SST skill/forecast performance is made anywhere. Claims cover algorithmic properties (exactness, scaling, resource accounting, leakage-aware CV) and relative method comparisons. External-validation roadmap: scripts/convert_netcdf4.py (a documented h5py-based converter from real Kaplan SST v2 netCDF-4 to the accepted .npy/.npz layout, runnable in an environment with h5py) -- not executed on this CPU-only stack.
exactness_qualification: 'Exact' ALWAYS means: exact for the embedded-torus kernel (verified 2.3e-12 rel), with the spectral floor (PSD projection) disclosed and eps-sensitivity measured, and the free-boundary modeling gap measured: rel gap shrinks with resolution (matern32 1.74->0.31, rbf 0.43->0.37 from 32x32 to 144x72).

pilot_gate.definition: spectral == dense-torus to 1e-6 rel (solve exactness for the torus kernel); torus-vs-free gap reported per kernel/ell (disclosed modeling qualification)

reconstruction.note: coverage 0.88-0.91 across masks at target 0.90: halo_w2 (0.881) below target; the framework is calibrated but not uniformly target-achieved -- reported as-is

masked_training.note: exact free-boundary PCG (2N-1 mirror-embedding matvec + floored-torus preconditioner) converges to tol=1e-8 (final rel residual 5e-9..8e-9); masked-input RMSE 0.78-0.83 is ~11x the full-field reconstruction 0.071 - quantified cost of missing inputs

enso_index.framing: gain over the zero-model ablation is small (~6%); functional beats climatology and the direct head is far worse (~16x) on this regime -- significance framed accordingly (no large-gain claim)

baselines.note: cross-month stationary-kernel pooling does not transfer (~field std, RMSE 1.25-1.27) -- informative negative; per-field parity vs sklearn measured separately

scaling.note: O(N log N) time / O(N) memory: sub-ms fits to N=10,368; ~42 MB peak estimated at 0.25-deg global -- far below the 7 GB cap; total pipeline 70.8 s

extrapolated: extrapolated_025deg_peak_rss_gb_est (42 MB via O(N) byte model)
measured_vs_extrapolated.protocol: wall_clock_s via monotonic timestamps around each arm; peak_rss_gb via getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss at arm boundaries

honesty_notes: FFT-kernel techniques are established literature (Gray 2006; Dietrich-Newsam 1997; Wilson-Nickisch 2015; Rahimi-Recht 2007). The contribution scoped = concrete circulant-block CPU implementation + systematic exact-vs-randomized CPU benchmark on climate grids + leakage-aware CV + resource accounting; no newness claim for FFT kernels.
Exactness qualified at every occurrence (embedded-torus qualification + floor + measured free-boundary gap).

Negative/neutral results reported as-is: pooled baselines fail to transfer; T1b masked-input RMSE ~11x full-field reconstruction; halo_w2 coverage 0.881 below target; optimism gap slightly negative; T2 functional gain over ablation ~6% (small).
Spectral floor disclosed with eigen diagnostics + eps sensitivity (RMSE insensitive to eps<=1e-6: 0.0945 vs 0.0945).
